geometry_edit: Preserved exact 20-vertex Purdue GIS FID 801 wall outline. Used directly identified NPS Photo 37 (caption: Kappa Delta Rho, Northwestern Ave, N, facing southeast; Jane Evans, June 2001) to refine the visible Tudor Revival facade: upper-story dark half-timbering, pale wall infill, an offset entry, steep gabled roof, three visible-slope dormers, and one visible chimney. Converted roof panels and schematic floor to closed thin slabs; retained the preview-only interior caveat.
architectural_uncertainties: Photo 37 is monochrome; exact facade color, material hues, dimensions, and concealed elevations remain uncertain. Wall finish is labeled an estimate; NPS district-wide form materials are not treated as building-specific proof.
Photo 37 supports a 2001 view toward the visible elevation and roof profile, but not surveyed wall or ridge heights; 7.5 m wall and 11.4 m ridge remain estimates.
Interior partitions and furnishings are generic schematic common-room, hall and dining zones, not an as-built plan. Far roof slope and opposite gable end are not shown clearly in Photo 37.
